title: An unusual exophytic palatal lesion with rapid growth
html: An 87-year-old woman came to the otorhinolaryngology service, her chief concern being a lesion on the hard palate, first noticed in 2020. Since 2022, the patient reported experiencing discomfort whenever she wore her complete upper denture. In June 2023, after she became unable to use her prosthesis, she informed her daughter about the pedunculated intraoral mass, which initially measured roughly 1.0 cm × 8.0 cm at its greatest dimensions. She subsequently visited an emergency department and was advised not to use her upper complete denture any longer.
